picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's selection to lead 13 projects and partner on 30+ more makes it the single largest anchor of DOE's new Genesis Mission, the week's dominant story combining AI, supercomputing, and quantum resources across the national lab system.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's role leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 others underscores how deeply DOE is committing its flagship computing infrastructure to AI-driven science.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ other federal agencies, elevates the initiative from a DOE program to a genuine whole-of-government AI strategy backed by executive order.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Imperial's Aron Walsh leading science at CuspAI, freshly valued at £2 billion after a £330 million raise, shows real venture capital betting big on AI-driven materials discovery spun out of academic research.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: A UW, Carnegie Mellon, and SLAC collaboration building a unified AI-driven cosmology data service represents exactly the kind of cross-institution scientific infrastructure the Genesis Mission is meant to enable.
picks.title: UW researchers join national effort to streamline AI-driven cosmology

picks.editorial_note: USC's national team developing AI models to predict turbulence has broad downstream applications in energy and transportation, a notable scientific bet with wide real-world reach.
picks.title: USC leads national AI research project to accelerate scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $20 million award to Boston University to help build a national 'cloud lab' network of automated, AI-infused research nodes is a major, non-Genesis-Mission investment in shared AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network

picks.editorial_note: NEURA Robotics and RWTH Aachen's roughly 3,000-square-meter facility for training humanoid and industrial robots marks a substantial academia-industry partnership pushing 'physical AI' into real deployment.
picks.title: A Milestone for Physical AI | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' collaboration with the FDA on a tool that detects hidden bias in medical AI training data addresses a critical real-world safety gap as clinical AI models proliferate.
picks.title: New tool detects hidden bias in medical AI

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83 million investment in integrated data systems and services builds foundational infrastructure meant to make scientific datasets AI-ready across the research community.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure
